notes.title: Full Translation + Gamepad Improvements
notes.content:
Fully translated game into several languages, now including all messages, texts, hints inside the main dungeon campaign.

Improved displaying of game controls, keyboard, mouse, gamepad buttons in the Options\Controls menu, now using graphics/images instead of text.

Added native support for multiple gamepads:
-Sony Dualshock 4
-Sony Dualsense
-Nintendo Switch Pro Controller
-8BitDo Pro 2

Added option to invert gamepad look direction.

Game is now on Sale with Limited Time Discount! :)

notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added Graphics Option to adjust Screen Brightness

[/list]

notes.title: Alternative Keyboard Layout
notes.content:
Added Alternative Keyboard Input based around arrow keys:
[list]
[*] Arrow Keys = Move
[*] Enter = Action (open door)
[*] / (SLASH) = Toggle weapons / Take all items
[*] DEL = Character Screen
[*] NumPad0 = Dash
[/list]

When trying to close door and it's blocked, a message will be shown on the screen.

notes.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
notes.content:
Added keyboard shortcuts for following actions:
[list]
[*] F1 .. F5 - Use Item
[*] Ctrl+MouseWheel - Change Item
[*] Ctrl - Walk slowly (instead of run)
[/list]

notes.title: How to Open Door Hint + Feedback Email
notes.content:

[*]Added option to enter your email address in the "Feedback" section if you need a reply
[/list]
